name: Prime Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2006, Prime Industries 
Ltd deals in Securities trading and allied activities[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1][2]
Company used to manufacture Vanaspati Ghee and at present is engaged in the manufacturing of all types of packaging material at its production unit in Harridwar, which includes:
a) HDPE/ PP bags
b) Non-woven PP bags for packaging edible items
c) BOPP laminated multi-colour printed bags, etc.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.43 Cr.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -30.9%
Working capital days have increased from 994 days to 3,061 days
